cases.name: Jessica Marie Lawrence
cases.about:
She was a lab technician at Cape Fear Valley Medical Center in Fayetteville, NC.

“She had a strong personality and was very loving and caring,” Isaac Hardy wrote on her memorial service website. Hardy wrote that the two got married on Valentine’s Day when they were young, and although they eventually divorced, they remained friends. “Her smile was radiant, and her laugh was just as funny,” he wrote, “she will be truly missed and will always have a special place in my heart.”
cases.narrative: On 10/25/2022, her body was found in a pile of trash in a wooded area off a dirt road. Her feet were bound with electrical cord and she had been burned beyond recognition.
